notes_for_editor: Thin record: two single-line listings and no history. Searches found an older New Mexico list giving 'Mt. Powell', Cibola NF, status 'Former', 8,851, 1933, credited to the Forest Service. That line appeared only in a search snippet: the list URL (firelookout.org/lookouts/lo-newmexico.html) returned 404 both in the cache and live, and no page read carries it, so the entry and the 1933 date are left out. A PeakVisor elevation of 8,757 ft also came only from a snippet and is not used. GNIS lists a summit named Mount Powell at 35.46703, -108.24071 in McKinley County (data/sources/gnis_places.json), which matches the brief's coordinates but is not a lookout source. Story is about 45 words, below the 120-word floor; kept short rather than padded.
